verdict.rationale: Publishing how a law firm uses AI in client service is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack names AI tools, an AI-use policy, or a Goodwin AI-practice product. The Founders Workbench Document Driver and calculators are free legal-tech tools, but nothing in the evidence describes them as AI, so they do not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the firm publishes how it uses AI in client service — named tools, policies, or AI-practice products of its own — beyond a marketing mention
